[Thinking]
**Explaining right triangle angles**

The user is asking about the angles in a right triangle. In a right triangle, one angle measures 90°. The other two angles combine to also equal 90°, making the total degrees in the triangle 180°. So, I’ll explain that there are 180° in total, highlighting that the right angle is 90° and the remaining two angles sum to 90°. I’ll make sure to provide this explanation concisely in Norwegian.
[/Thinking]

I en rettvinklet trekant er én vinkel 90°. Summen av vinklene i en trekant er alltid 180°, så de to andre vinklene må til sammen være 90°. Totalen er altså 180°.
